content.title:
Scored quiz
Module 3
content.intro: This quiz covers all the lessons in this module. You must achieve 80% to pass. Good luck!

questions.prompt: What is a key origin of the concept of a just energy transition?

options.value: A UN intergovernmental panel on emissions
Trade unions advocating for worker protections

correct.title: Correct
correct.body: The term originated in trade union movements, emphasizing worker protections during environmental reforms.

wrong.title: Incorrect
wrong.body: The term originated in trade union movements, emphasizing worker protections during environmental reforms.

questions.prompt: Which principle is central to achieving a just transition across diverse contexts?

correct.title: Correct
correct.body: Tailored strategies are crucial to account for regional disparities, social dynamics, and economic contexts.

wrong.title: Incorrect
wrong.body: Tailored strategies are crucial to account for regional disparities, social dynamics, and economic contexts.

questions.prompt: What does “energy justice” emphasize most clearly?

options.value: Equal distribution of energy benefits and burdens

correct.title: Correct
correct.body: Energy justice focuses on equitable access, fair distribution, and inclusion in energy decisions.

wrong.title: Incorrect
wrong.body: Energy justice focuses on equitable access, fair distribution, and inclusion in energy decisions.

questions.prompt: Which of the following best describes a procedural justice approach in energy planning?

options.value: Including stakeholders in all phases of project design

correct.title: Correct
correct.body: Procedural justice requires inclusive, transparent participation in all phases of energy planning.

wrong.title: Incorrect
wrong.body: Procedural justice requires inclusive, transparent participation in all phases of energy planning.

questions.prompt: What challenge may arise from a poorly planned shift away from fossil fuels in extractive-dependent regions?

correct.title: Correct
correct.body: Rapid transitions without economic alternatives can destabilize communities dependent on extractive industries.

wrong.title: Incorrect
wrong.body: Rapid transitions without economic alternatives can destabilize communities dependent on extractive industries.

questions.prompt: What is a key gender-related barrier to equitable participation in the energy transition?

options.value: Lack of interest among women in energy jobs
Women's preference for informal energy solutions
Underrepresentation in leadership and unequal access to training and financing

correct.title: Correct
correct.body: Structural barriers—such as limited access to training, financing, and leadership roles—limit women's full participation in the energy sector.

wrong.title: Incorrect
wrong.body: Structural barriers—such as limited access to training, financing, and leadership roles—limit women's full participation in the energy sector.

questions.prompt: Why is land tenure security essential in renewable energy deployment in the Global South?

options.value: It ensures lower electricity prices for communities
It prevents displacement, protects community rights, and ensures equitable benefit sharing
It allows governments to bypass consultation requirements

correct.title: Correct
correct.body: Secure land rights help prevent displacement, protect livelihoods, and facilitate fair participation in renewable energy benefits.

wrong.title: Incorrect
wrong.body: Secure land rights help prevent displacement, protect livelihoods, and facilitate fair participation in renewable energy benefits.

questions.prompt: What is a major environmental concern linked to large-scale hydropower projects?

options.value: Disruption of aquatic ecosystems and methane emissions from reservoirs

correct.title: Correct
correct.body: Large-scale hydropower can disrupt river ecosystems and emit methane from decomposing biomass in reservoirs, especially in tropical zones.

wrong.title: Incorrect
wrong.body: Large-scale hydropower can disrupt river ecosystems and emit methane from decomposing biomass in reservoirs, especially in tropical zones.

questions.prompt: Which strategy promotes equitable economic opportunities in energy transitions?

correct.title: Correct
correct.body: Skills development and retraining enable workers and communities to benefit from new energy sectors.

wrong.title: Incorrect
wrong.body: Skills development and retraining enable workers and communities to benefit from new energy sectors.

questions.prompt: What is the role of Free, Prior and Informed Consent (FPIC) in just transitions?

options.value: To ensure indigenous communities have decision-making power over energy projects
To limit access to natural resources

correct.title: Correct
correct.body: FPIC ensures that Indigenous peoples are meaningfully involved in decisions affecting their lands and lives.

wrong.title: Incorrect
wrong.body: FPIC ensures that Indigenous peoples are meaningfully involved in decisions affecting their lands and lives.
